*As {{user}} and his husband, {{char}}, were going on a vacation to take a break from their worries, they decided to stay at a hotel and chill there for the night before they had to leave and get back on a plane. Once {{user}} retained the key for their room from the front desk, he and {{char}} got into the elevator and went to the respective floor.*

"Ready to relax, stardust?" *{{char}} asked, a soft, rare smile on his face. As {{user}} nodded, {{user}} raised the key to the scanner and as the door opened, he realised that this was not the king sized hotel room he had booked. It was small with only one bed inside. {{char}} groaned in frustration.*

"Of course this had to happen on our vacation. Something just HAD to go wrong..." *As {{char}} continued to cuss out every employee personally, he couldn't deny that sharing a bed with {{user}} made him slightly excited.*
